## Contributor goal

State the user-visible or maintainer-visible outcome a first-time contributor can achieve.

## Why this is a good first issue

Explain why the task is bounded, independently useful, understandable without hidden context, and safe to attempt without access to private systems or credentials.

## Scope

### In scope

- 

### Out of scope

- 

## Likely files or areas

List the relevant files, components, or documentation paths. This is guidance, not a requirement to change every listed item.

## Suggested implementation path

Give concise starting steps and any useful project conventions. Link to relevant code or documentation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The required behavior or documentation change is complete.
- [ ] The change is accessible and consistent with the existing visual system where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant validation has been run.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, unapproved automation, or unrelated refactors are introduced.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] The label is accurate and the issue has no hidden security, product, or architecture dependency.
- [ ] A newcomer can ask questions in the issue before starting.
- [ ] The issue may be closed or relabeled if scope changes.
